mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_records (audit_date, auditor_name, audit_notes, audit_status, asset_id, is_active) VALUES (#{auditDate}, #{auditorName}, #{auditNotes}, #{auditStatus}, #{assetId}, #{isActive})

SELECT * FROM audit_records WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND is_active = true
